newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Mir crew opens hatch to supply ship.
newsitem.headline: Mir crew opens hatch to supply ship.

text.p: Cosmonauts on board Russia's Mir space station opened the hatch leading to a docked supply ship on Tuesday, and are ready to start unloading tools crucial for the troubled mission, flight control officials said.

"They opened the hatch and will be unloading soon," Viktor Blagov, deputy flight director, told Reuters, adding that the operation would take three days to complete. The unmanned Progress craft delivered oxygen, food, water and tools needed for repairs in the Spektr module, badly damaged on June 25 when another supply ship ploughed into the ageing space station.
